text: ## Connection and exceptional cases
source_side_note: Actual local proof/application; compare available statement and required premise before adding consumer locations.

text: A is projective over F, so an ample F-line bundle supplies an F-defined polarization if none was fixed already. After base extension to an algebraic closure, this polarization is the line-bundle homomorphism to which Lemma16.2(e) applies. Alternation can be checked after that extension. The torsion pairing and lambda are defined over F, so their composition is G_F-equivariant. The compatible perfect torsion pairings give a perfect rational Tate pairing. Because lambda is an isogeny, V_5(lambda) is invertible: an isogeny inverse up to a nonzero integer becomes an inverse after tensoring with Q_5. Thus the composition is nondegenerate even when 5 divides the degree of lambda. No principal polarization, prime-to-5 degree, or good reduction at 5 is required. G_F acts on Q_5(1) by epsilon_5, which is the multiplier of this alternating form.
